headline: Hefner's Way subdivision hearing continued to November 19th, 2026 and deadline for action extended to December 31st.
summary: Energy North, Incorporated, asked to delay the Hefner's Way hearing, and members agreed to the new date. The applicant also said 46 Millett Street is no longer part of the plan. Members discussed a second site visit and a request to add waivers to the October 1st minutes.
decisions: Approved 7-0 extending the time to act on the Hefner's Way plan to December 31st.
Continued the Hefner's Way public hearing to November 19th, 2026, by a 7-0 roll call vote.
discussion: Hefner's Way site visit: Members discussed rescheduling the visit, possibly with the applicant present, because some members missed it. Photos from the earlier visit were said not to show much of the wooded site.
October 1st minutes: Members said a specific list of waivers was not in the minutes, and the review was moved to the next meeting.
46 Millett Street removal: The applicant said 46 Millett Street is no longer part of the plan, so the chair said it will be removed from the agenda.
